item.title: Line of Duty revisits storyline that caused 'genuine anger' for viewers in new series
item.description: Line of Duty's seventh series will reportedly see the storyline of 'H' continue after the ending of series 6 caused 'genuine anger' for fans.

item.title: Tesco apologises to shoppers as 'do not eat' warning issued due to salmonella
item.description: During testing, Tesco detected salmonella in the fruit product sold at supermarkets across the UK

item.title: 'Too often they feel forgotten' - Support for veterans is highlighted at forum
item.description: Veterans must be heard and supported, says an MP who is determined to make sure their voices reach the highest levels of Government.

item.title: Fundraiser for family of mum who died in Conwy A55 crash passes £15,000
item.description: A fundraiser set up for the family of a woman who died in a crash on the A55 in Conwy has passed £15,000.

item.title: Snowy conditions expected as Met Office issues weather warning for North Wales
item.description: The Met Office has issued a weather warning for snow which will affect parts of North Wales from tomorrow afternoon (February 18).

item.title: Reports of 'dangerous dog' at Mochdre property prompts police response
item.description: Police attended a property in Conwy yesterday (February 16) after reports of a "dangerous dog" being kept there.

item.title: 'I'm not ready to die' - Mum with cancer seeks alternative treatment to live longer
item.description: A single mum from Rhos-on-Sea with terminal cancer has urged women to check their breasts, as she seeks alternative treatments to slow down the illness.

item.title: Llandudno Junction man, 28, charged with assault of emergency worker and affray
item.description: A man has been charged with a spate of offences, including the assault of an emergency worker, following his arrest in Llandudno Junction yesterday (February 16).

item.title: Friends complete epic 44‑mile walk between Llandudno and Bangor piers
item.description: Two friends from Llandudno have completed a gruelling walk from Llandudno Pier to Bangor Pier and back again to raise money for a charity "close to their hearts".

item.title: DIY ‘Beast’ smashes world speed record at North Wales airfield
item.description: A motorcycle engineer has smashed a world record at Llanbedr Airfield after building a drone‑powered remote control car capable of hitting 234mph — a home‑made ‘Beast’ that now stands as the fastest RC car ever recorded.
